summary.text: April Miller is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 4 who was elected in November 2022 and has served since January 11, 2023.
Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate list shows April Fleming Miller as an incumbent running in District 4; an optometrist, she serves on the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: April Miller was born in Washington, D.C., on October 5, 1970, and graduated from Middletown High School in 1988, according to her General Assembly biography.

She earned a B.A. in biology and psychology from the University of Maryland, Baltimore County, in 1992 and a doctorate of optometry from Salus University in 1996, and she practices as an optometrist with Drs. Nathan and Miller in Frederick.
Miller served on the Frederick County Board of Education from 2010 to 2018 and has been a trustee of Frederick Community College since 2019.
In the House she has served on the Ways and Means Committee since 2023 and in 2026 is on its K-12 Education and Child Care subcommittees.
